title: Farm and soil
description: Soil health reports and crop advice for farmers
summary: This page shows soil health test results for villages in this district from the Soil Health Card portal, and weekly crop advisories from the local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) and ICAR. Each advisory shows the week it is for, and each soil report shows the date the soil was tested.
